translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: Jahua’ tejhua’methanchat an t’ocat inic Juan

content: An ángel ax in chal i tsacam thuchath u
Ani u tsu’u jun i ángel al i tocou pa’iy ti eb lej pulic in ey. In cua’al cuechochol tin oc’ ejtil i pits’al. Maq’uiq’uil in hual ejtil a q’uicha ani in acanchic ejtil i c’amal.
In cua’al tin c’ubac jun i tsacam thuchath u calputhits. In cuba’ in huinab acan ba’ am pulic lejem ani in c’uatab acan ba’ an tsabal.
Thajan lej tsapic, ejtil max mururul i tsoj, ani tiq’uele tam cahuin buc i mamlab.

Tam ti talits ti cau nixe’ xi buc i mamlab, ne’etsac cu thucha’ jahua’ in ulumalchic ani tamna’ u ats’a’ tal ti eb jun i cau tin ucha’: ―Yab ca thucha’ ani yab ca olna’ jahua’ in ulumal xi mamlabchic.
Tam in thaya’ in c’ubac ti eb nixe’ xi ángel axi cubat jun in acan ba’ am pulic lejem ani axi jum ba’ an tsabal.

In cubal a Dios ti lej chubax. Ja’its a Dios in ts’ejca’ an eb ani an tsabal ani am pulic lejem. Ja’its axi ejat abal ets’ey. In ulu an ángel antse’: ―Hue’its ani am bucchilab ángel ne’ets quin juchuy jaye an trompeta ax in chal.

Tam quim baju am pejath hora ne’ets quin juchuy, tamna’its a Dios ne’ets quin t’aja’ jahua’ in tsinat tsalpayamalits ne’ets quin t’aja’. Expith in caulomejilchic axi t’ojnal c’al jaja’ quin exla’ jahua’ a Dios ne’ets quin t’aja’ cum q’uejab olchinenequits in tsalap a Dios.

Ani jaja’ ax tin taunamal ti eb, tam u ats’a’ tin taunal junil. In uchan: ―Quit utey ca bats’u an tsacam calputh thuchath u tin c’ubac an ángel axi cubat jun in acan ba’ am pulic lejem ani axi jum ba’ an tsabal.
Tam tin utey c’al an ángel ani u conchi an tsacam thuchath u, tam tin ucha’: ―Ca bats’u ani ca c’apu. Ta hui’ ne’ets ca leca’ tsi’ic ejtil an tsi’im ani ta chucul ne’ets ca ats’a’ ts’a’ic.
Tam u bats’u an tsacam thuchath u ax in cua’al an ángel, ani u c’apu. Ani chubax u leca’ tsi’ic tu hui’ ani talbel ts’a’ic tu chucul.

Taley in uchan: ―Pel a uchbil ca olnaye jahua’ a Dios ne’ets quin t’ajchi axi yantalam i bichouchic ani i pactha’ bichoulomchic. Quin t’ajchi xi yantalamchic i ts’ale ani i inicchic jahuaquits tam cahuintalab quin cauna’.
